visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women stand in a brightly lit hallway wearing matching light blue jerseys and white pleated skirts. They look at the camera with neutral expressions, preparing for a performance. The background shows white walls with office doors and some team branding. (2) The group performs a rhythmic dance, moving their hands down and up in sync with an unheard beat. They smile broadly and blink playfully at the lens. The camera remains mostly static while they maintain a triangular formation. (3) The camera zooms in as the woman on the right leans forward, pouting and making a finger-pointing gesture. Shortly after, the woman on the left leans in close to the lens, sticking her tongue out playfully while smiling, creating dynamic close-up interactions. (4) The three women move back into their group pose. They all look at the camera together. The central woman sticks out her tongue and points to her cheeks, while the others make playful hand gestures, ending the sequence with high energy.
